macro_regime.regime_summary: Macro transition into disinflationary soft landing. Capital is no longer free: companies with strong Free Cash Flow, pricing power, and near-zero debt refinancing risk will decisively compound over 3-5 years.

picks.name: Alphabet Inc.
picks.rate_impact: Net cash fortress ($110B+). High rates earn billions in interest income while starving unprofitable AI competitors.
picks.thesis: Secular AI moat with proprietary TPU infrastructure, YouTube subscriptions, and Android/Search ecosystem. Valuation trades at a notable discount to MegaCap tech peers despite unmatched computing scale.
catalysts: Enterprise Gemini API integration across Google Cloud accelerating margins
Waymo autonomous commercial scaling expanding to multi-city operations
New capital return policy via expanding dividends and aggressive share buybacks
risks: Search query cannibalization by conversational AI interfaces

picks.name: Microsoft Corporation
picks.rate_impact: AAA credit rating (stronger than US government). Mission-critical enterprise software seat retention ensures recurring pricing power regardless of Fed hikes.
picks.thesis: Supreme enterprise enterprise software monopoly with Azure Cloud capturing the lion's share of Fortune 500 AI deployments. High switching costs create an insurmountable recurring cash flow moat.
catalysts: Copilot ARR ramp reaching broad enterprise seat renewal cycles
Azure OpenAI services capacity expansions unlocking enterprise backlog
High double-digit dividend growth supported by $70B+ annual free cash flow
risks: Massive AI data center Capex causing near-term margin friction
Potential deceleration in PC commercial hardware upgrades

picks.name: NVIDIA Corporation
picks.rate_impact: Massive gross margins (75%+) and tens of billions in pure net cash. Client capex budgets remain committed even in restrictive monetary regimes.
picks.thesis: CUDA software ecosystem creates standard architectural lock-in across all modern AI research. Blackwell platform transition sets a generational multi-year compute refresh across hyperscalers and sovereign nations.
catalysts: Blackwell architecture volume ramp with full hyperscaler allocation pre-sold
Sovereign AI infrastructure buildouts across Europe, Japan, and the Middle East
Enterprise software licensing and DGX Cloud recurring margin contribution
risks: Cyclical semiconductor capacity digestion cycles in 2026+
Geopolitical export curbs restricting access to secondary Asian markets

picks.name: Amazon.com Inc.
picks.rate_impact: Regionalized fulfillment network cuts transport and capital intensity, shielding domestic retail margins from inflationary cost pressures.
picks.thesis: Operating margin expansion cycle underway as AWS cloud re-accelerates, retail fulfillment costs decline via robotics automation, and ultra-high-margin ad business scales past $50B.
catalysts: AWS custom Trainium2 & Inferentia2 chips driving low-cost enterprise AI workloads
Prime Video advertising monetization reaching full ad-tier maturity
Warehouse robotics automation unlocking structural 300bps operating margin expansion
risks: Consumer discretionary spending slowdown under lingering credit card debt burdens
Intense cloud competition from Azure and Google Cloud

picks.name: Eli Lilly and Company
picks.rate_impact: Inelastic pharmaceutical demand makes earnings virtually immune to Federal Reserve interest rate decisions or recessions.
picks.thesis: Incretin metabolic revolution leader (Mounjaro / Zepbound) with expanding indications in sleep apnea, cardiovascular disease, and liver fibrosis (MASH). Massive multi-decade commercial runway.
catalysts: Manufacturing supply capacity ramp bringing millions of unfulfilled patients online
Cardiovascular and Alzheimer's (Kisunla) Medicare reimbursement expansion
Next-generation oral GLP-1 molecule (Orforglipron) phase 3 data readout
risks: Compounding pharmacies attempting legal generic workarounds during shortages
High initial valuation multiples requiring sustained 25%+ top-line beats
